entities.name: Dinosaurs
entities.description: Prehistoric reptile-like creatures found on many planes, most prominently Ixalan, where they are the dominant wildlife.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane whose jungles are dominated by brightly feathered dinosaurs and home to the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The human civilization of Ixalan that controls some dinosaurs and rides them into battle.

entities.name: Kinjalli
entities.description: The being the Sun Empire believes made the dinosaurs out of stone.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artificer who taught Sun Empire engineers to build mechanical dinosaurs and kept master keys of her own.

entities.name: Mechanoquetzacama
entities.description: Mechanical dinosaurs built for the Sun Empire's invasion of Torrezon, loyal to whoever holds their command codes.

entities.name: Elder Dinosaurs
entities.description: Ancient, wild gray-scaled, gold-feathered dinosaurs preserved in Orazca that can be commanded through the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The Golden City where the Elder Dinosaurs were preserved.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact whose power lets the Sun Empire warriors who wield it command the Elder Dinosaurs.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A Sun Empire warrior who took two years to memorize the tale of the Elder Dinosaurs.

entities.name: Selvala of Alberon
entities.description: A figure on Fiora able to call feathered raptorial dinosaurs and other beasts.

entities.name: Saurid Autocracy
entities.description: The mightiest state on Muraganda, ruled by humanoid saurids over human subjects called softskins.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane to which a dinosaur herd traveled through an Omenpath.

events.summary: Saheeli Rai teaches Sun Empire engineers to build dozens of mechanical dinosaurs for the invasion of Torrezon.
events.quote: Saheeli Rai taught Sun Empire engineers to produce dozens of mechanical dinosaurs

events.summary: A herd of dinosaurs follows a Scalestorm Summoner through an Omenpath to Thunder Junction.
events.quote: A herd of dinosaurs followed a Scalestorm Summoner through an Omenpath to Thunder Junction

relations.note: Sun Empire belief that Kinjalli made them from stone.
relations.quote: The humans of the Sun Empire believe them to be creations of Kinjalli

relations.note: She taught the engineers to produce them.
relations.quote: Saheeli Rai taught Sun Empire engineers to produce dozens of mechanical dinosaurs

relations.note: Controls some dinosaurs without domesticating them.
relations.quote: some are controlled by the Sun Empire

relations.note: Lets its wielders command the Elder Dinosaurs.
relations.quote: the power of the Immortal Sun gives the Sun Empire warriors who wield it the ability to bring these elder dinosaurs under their command
